artifacts.name: raw_intent.json
artifacts.purpose: Preserve the exact user request and its byte identity.

artifacts.name: intent_ir.json
artifacts.purpose: Represent objectives, requested outcomes, intent constraints, ambiguities, contradictions, and unknowns.

artifacts.name: intent_validation.json
artifacts.purpose: Record deterministic structural and referential validation results.

artifacts.name: intent_fidelity.json
artifacts.purpose: Record whether the semantic interpretation faithfully preserves the raw request.

artifacts.name: requirement_ir.json
artifacts.purpose: Compile accepted intent into workflow-independent, evidence-bearing obligations.

artifacts.name: requirement_validation.json
artifacts.purpose: Record deterministic requirement integrity and verifier-binding checks.

artifacts.name: requirement_coverage.json
artifacts.purpose: Prove that every objective, outcome, and intent constraint is represented by requirements.

artifacts.name: compilation_trace.json
artifacts.purpose: Bind compiler stages, artifact identities, decisions, and file digests.

design_support.name: field_consumer_matrix.json
design_support.purpose: Reject fields that do not drive a downstream decision or integrity check.

design_support.name: generalization_cases.json
design_support.purpose: Exercise the proposed fields and routing decisions across diverse prompt classes.

design_support.name: validate_contract_examples.py
design_support.purpose: Run deterministic integrity and generalization checks over this incubator.

canonical_naming: Accepted artifacts use the unqualified filename only after their acceptance gates pass.
